subject: ORBIT: Mutual Action Playbook for GPU pool commit and eval gating
messages:
From: Ellis Park <ellis.park@medtechsys.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tina Gomes <tina.gomes@procuremedtech.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ORBIT kickoff — MAP and capacity windows

Marcus — thanks for the kickoff today. We're aligned on agreeing a Mutual Action Playbook (MAP) that ties evaluation milestones to a capacity reservation window. A couple constraints from our side:

- Procurement needs a signed SOW or an MSA amendment before finance will lock any hardware commits; timeline is 6-8 weeks post-SOW for PO issuance.
- Our infra lead requires a 4-week notice for dedicated GPU pool provisioning for private deployments; shorter for hosted but we need predictable nodes for benchmarking.
- Our eval team needs a staged gating plan: smoke tests (3 days), performance eval (7 days), accuracy eval (7 days).

Can you share a MAP draft that maps those gates into a commit timeline + recommended GPU pool sizing? We expect to start evaluation early July and would look to reserve capacity no later than late July if the eval goes well.

Thanks,
Ellis
Ellis Park
Head of Platform Engineering
MedTech Systems
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ellis Park <ellis.park@medtechsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ORBIT kickoff — MAP and capacity windows

Ellis — appreciate the clear constraints. Attached is a first-pass MAP PDF and a fast-sizing workbook; high level below. We kept the gating aligned to your smoke/perf/accuracy windows so procurement and provisioning line up with your PO cadence.

Highlight (TL;DR):
- MAP phases: Kickoff & baseline (week 0), Smoke (w1), Perf (w2), Accuracy & edge-cases (w3), Final validation & sign-off (w4).
- Commitment window: Soft reserve requested by Jul 20, hard PO by Jul 30 to hit an Aug 24 dedicated pool availability (4 weeks provisioning). If you opt for hosted + burst, we can shorten to ~2 weeks but throughput will be variable.
- Recommended pool: Start 16 x A10G-equivalent GPUs for eval scale (sustained 150 tokens/sec aggregate estimate). Post-validation, scale to 64 GPUs for production baseline. Workbook outlines three sizing scenarios (conservative/expected/high).
- Acceptance criteria: smoke pass, perf SLA (95% quantile < 250ms for 1k token batches), model quality delta < 2% on your labeled set.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm procurement SLA: soft-reserve vs PO dates.
2) We finalize MAP and share with procurement/legal for SOW template.
3) Redwood schedules a staging GPU tranche for your team Aug 24 and a canary slot Aug 31.

Attaching: ORBIT_MAP_v1.pdf, gpu-sizing-estimate.xlsx

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Tina Gomes <tina.gomes@procuremedtech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ellis Park <ellis.park@medtechsys.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ORBIT kickoff — MAP and capacity windows

Marcus / Ellis — procurement here. Couple of practical notes that will affect the MAP timeline:

- We can execute a standard SOW within 10 business days once we receive the draft and a pricing appendix. That would push PO issuance to roughly 4 weeks after the SOW if internal approvals go smoothly.
- We need the following from Redwood to attach to the SOW: SOC 2 attestation date, data handling addendum, sample invoice showing monthly commit.
- On sizing: procurement prefers a phased commit (initial 3-month reservation for 16 GPUs, then an optional top-up to 64 GPUs) to limit upfront fiscal exposure.

If Marcus can split the MAP into an evaluation tranche + production tranche and include a phased billing example in the appendix, procurement and finance will have what they need to commit.

Regards,
Tina Gomes
Senior Procurement Manager
MedTech Systems
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ellie? <ellis.park@medtechsys.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ORBIT kickoff — MAP and capacity windows

Ellis / team — looping in the capacity & product ops notes. Reworked the MAP to include a phased reservation and a staging canary approach:

- Phase A (Eval tranche): 16 GPUs reserved for 6 weeks (3-week active eval + buffer). Billing: monthly pro-rata; credit back for unused committed hours if < 60% utilization in tranche.
- Phase B (Prod tranche): option to expand to 64 GPUs with 3-month minimum commit, auto-renew unless PO specifies otherwise.
- Provisioning: staging pool provisioned 14 days after PO for on-prem/private; we can provision hosted-on-dedicated within 7 days with guaranteed capacity routes.
- Contingency: access to burst pool (hosted) for 2 weeks during perf runs while dedicated pool finishes allocation.

I'll update the pricing appendix to show the phased commit example and add SOC2 attestation and a sample invoice. Marcus / Ben — can you confirm the canary dates (we recommended Aug 31) and that the billing credit clause is acceptable?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ellis Park <ellis.park@medtechsys.com>, Tina Gomes <tina.gomes@procuremedtech.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ORBIT kickoff — MAP and capacity windows

Quick confirmation:
- Canary slot Aug 31 confirmed for a 48-hour canary. We'll reserve a 16-GPU staging tranche from Aug 24 to allow a week of pre-canary warm-up.
- Pricing appendix: I'll add the phased billing example and the credit-for-unused-hours clause and circulate by end of day Thursday (Jun 18).
- SOC2: latest report attached to the SOW packet (we'll put the attestation date and link in the DocuSign bundle).

Ellis / Tina — if those dates work, we'll mark Jul 20 as the soft reservation target (you'll receive the soft-reserve confirmation email) and Jul 30 as the PO deadline for hitting the Aug 24 provisioning target. If procurement wants an alternate PO date, flag it and we'll rework the MAP timeline.

Ben Carter
Principal Product Ops | Redwood Inference
